steps: Toast the kataifi strands until golden and crisp
Crush the toasted strands into small, crunchy pieces
Mix with pistachio cream for flavor and binding
Melt the chocolate in a bowl over warm water
Dip fresh strawberries halfway into the chocolate
Place on a tray to let the coating set in the fridge
Spoon the pistachio kunafa mixture into a cup
Place the chocolate-dipped strawberry on top
Serve immediately for best texture contrast

swaps.use: crushed prawn crackers or fried shallots
swaps.why: kataifi is hard to find locally; prawn crackers offer similar crunch

hooks: The Dubai trend is here, but simpler.
Chocolate dipped strawberry with a twist.
